slice_title: Fail-closed repertory safety and provenance contract
finding: Hourly selection and continuity were covered, but repertory safety constraints and provenance classes lacked an independent verifier.
verified_claims: The committed verifier requires deterministic selection, privacy protection, commerce exclusion, explicit-gesture audio, reduced-motion support, mobile safety, accessibility, performance, and immutable deployment identity before activation.
Each production must retain observed, inferred, experiment, and current_decision provenance classes.
Exactly one observed current stage is permitted and it must retain observed-source evidence.
privacy_boundary: No private source material is included; only abstract public-safe provenance classifications are validated.
next_action: Run all repertory tests in an authenticated checkout and retain the output without attempting an application deployment while the provider-capacity blocker remains.
